contract.application_relevance: Workers accept small binary uploads alongside Unicode captions.
contract.cleanup: Every case is awaited before cleanup. Track explicit readers and body streams; cancel/release readers, initiate all unlocked-stream cancellations before joining them, and retain no request-local objects. Buffered body producers may be lazy; explicit JS stream producers are finite and close synchronously. Cleanup records runtime-retained locks with awaited consumer/descendant proof, and any unverified lock blocks acceptance. No open producer gates, external handles or timers are used. Await both Y220 consumers with allSettled. If a body method or cleanup does not settle within the external deadline, supervisor terminates only the owned process group and records failure/unknown plus incomplete cleanup. It never reports a pass.
contract.desired_behavior: File bytes [0,255,128,13,10,65] are unchanged; caption is café, filename bytes.bin, type application/octet-stream.
contract.distinctness: Binary multipart part ownership and separate text decoding, absent from H-series host-body byte forwarding.
fixed_runtime_assertions: t.deep([...form.keys()], ['upload', 'caption'], 'multipart byte scanner retains part order');
t.equal(file instanceof File, true, 'filename parameter creates File value');
t.equal(file.name, 'bytes.bin', 'file name decoded from part header');
t.deep([...new Uint8Array(await file.arrayBuffer())], [0, 255, 128, 13, 10, 65], 'binary file bytes are never UTF-8 replaced');
t.equal(form.get('caption'), 'café', 'text part is UTF-8 decoded independently');
contract.hypothesis: Decoding the entire multipart body as text before splitting parts may corrupt legal binary file bytes.
contract.mechanism: Multipart byte scanner separates text headers from binary file payloads

Native celld Blob, File, FormData, Request, Response, and ReadableStream globals; no mocks or implementation extraction.
External five-second case deadline plus independent 300-second suite deadline and owned cleanup are active.
